resources.string: Five correct marks! A free power is ready.
Five correct marks. Your two power slots are full.
False claim — Shield used. Your ticket stays in play.
False claim — this ticket is out for this round.
Shield automatically forgives one false prize claim. It can protect each ticket once per round. Without an available Shield, a false claim discards only that ticket; earlier wins remain valid.
Auto-Dab marks already called and newly called numbers on one ticket for 15 seconds. Use once per ticket. Automatic marks do not earn powers.
Arm a 25% bonus on one ticket before claiming. Its next successful prize earns extra virtual coins after the final pool split, rounded down. Use once per ticket. Other winners keep their full share.

Power rooms: every five new correct manual marks across your tickets earns one free random power: Shield, Auto-Dab or Prize bonus, each equally likely (1 in 3). Hold at most two. A full inventory skips that drop. Powers expire with the round. Wrong taps are rejected. Late and duplicate claims do not discard tickets. No cash value.
Every 5 correct marks earns a free power. False claims discard that ticket unless a Shield saves it.
No powers. False claims receive a warning; all tickets stay in play.
Practice personas are simulated opponents. Friends tables contain invited players only.
